Returns alert details based on the alert IDs.

items.docs:
*[Analytics Endpoint]*

The data returned is in UTC.

info.name: Returns alert details based on the parameters.

params.name: startTimeUtc
params.description: Start time in UTC (YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss). Specify an End time if Start time is set.

params.name: endTimeUtc
params.description: End time in UTC (YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss). Specify a Start time if End time is set.

params.name: levelId
params.description: Alert level Id. (Warning = 0, Critical = 1, Information = 2, Improved = 3)

params.name: testName
params.description: Test name to filter alerts for

params.name: testIds
params.description: Comma-separated list of test IDs to filter alerts for

params.name: alertTypeSubId
params.description: Alert Type Sub ID (refer InternalLink[Test Enumeration Endpoint,operations-tag-Test,operations-Test-get_v2_tests_enumeration])

params.name: productIds
params.description: Comma-separated list of Product IDs to filter alerts for

params.name: productName
params.description: Product name to filter alerts for

params.name: acknowledgedBy
params.description: Contact ID that acknowledged the test alert

params.name: pageNumber
params.description: Page number to return records from when the number of records exceeds pageSize

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of results per page. Maximum value is 100.

items.docs:
*[Analytics Endpoint]*

If no time is specified, the alerts from the last 24 hours are returned. The data returned is in UTC.

The request body requires 3 keys to be filled with appropriate value as listed below.

* **alertId** - Alert ID

* **acknowledgeAlert** - set to true or false

* **dropAlert** - set to true or false

* **assignToContactByEmail** - email address string
